config:
config-version: 8
server:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: PORT
management:
  disable-control-panel: true
requests:
  nonstream-keepalive-interval: 1
  passthrough-headers: true
  payload:
    override:
      - models:
          - name: grok-voice-tts-1.0
            protocol: openai
        params:
          language: de
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTHDIR
api-keys:
  xai:
    - name: xai-1
      base-url: http://UPSTREAM/v1
      keys:
        - api-key: sk-fake-xai-a
        - api-key: sk-fake-xai-b
